_help: Act 2, the labour market: hiring Khalil Darwish's local labourers (hired_khalil), 25 up front, or 13 now and 12 owed (owe_khalil). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

fatima.speaker: fatima
fatima.line: I am Fatima el-Sayed. I place good workers with good employers, and I remember which employers were not. Khalil Darwish's men are dockworkers without docks. Strong, and cheap.

already.speaker: khalil
already.line: My men are fed and ready. Thank you for that.

first.speaker: khalil
first.line: Khalil Darwish. My men will lift anything, dig anything, for honest pay. Half of them have been cheated before.

choices.label: Hire the crew
choices.line: I need strong backs. How much?

fee.speaker: khalil
fee.line: Twenty-five pounds. And my men want to know they will be paid.

choices.label: Pay it all now
choices.line: Twenty-five, up front. Nobody gets cheated.

choices.label: Half now, half later
choices.line: Thirteen now, the rest when we're back.

joined.speaker: khalil
joined.line: Paid before a single stone is lifted. My men will not forget it.

joined_owed.speaker: khalil
joined_owed.line: Half. Very well. They will work, and they will be waiting for the other half.
